Running command: cd /tmp && python3 -c "
import struct
RLI=0x2067; LRI=0x2066; PDI=0x2069
seq=[]
# 125 isolates alternating RLI, LRI to increase level by 1 each
for i in range(125):
    seq.append(RLI if i%2==0 else LRI)
# 125 PDIs
seq += [PDI]*125
data = b''.join(struct.pack('<I', c) for c in seq)
open('/tmp/poc_iso.bin','wb').write(data)
print('wrote', len(data), 'bytes,', len(seq), 'chars')
"
